newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch.

text.p: Stocks to watch this morning: * Intel Corp reported third quarter earnings of $1.3 billion, or $1.48 per share, a 40 percent rise from a year ago. Wall Street analysts' consensus estimate was $1.25.
* Chase Manhattan Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings of $1.82, according to First Call, versus $1.55 a year ago.
* PepsiCo is expected to report third quarter earnings of $0.33 a share versus $0.39 a year ago, according to First Call.
* Merrill Lynch & Co Inc third quarter results are due today. According to Zacks, analysts' mean estimate is $1.60 a share.
* Time Warner Inc third-quarter profits are expected. According to Zacks, the mean estimate is a loss of $0.36 a share. The shares fell 1/2 to 41-1/4 on Monday.
* Texas Instruments reported third quarter earnings of $0.23 a share versus $1.48 a year ago. According to Zacks, the mean estimate was $0.20. Shares rose 1/8 to 55-5/8 on Monday.
* CSX Corp announced it is merging with Conrail Inc. CSX shares closed off 1/4 to 49-1/2 on Monday, while Conrail was unchanged at 71.
